scope: Source-owned four-cofactor identity review and separate counterfactual input admission; no new Gibbs-energy labels, quantum calculations or automatic modification of ModelSEED.
reference_choice: Use exactly the ChEBI IDs already present in the pinned ModelSEED compound cross-references. Verify currently retrieved primary records and local benchmark identity; do not choose by prediction accuracy.
primary_checks: Exact source charge, formula, InChIKey and molecular graph versus owned ChEBI/PubChem records
Unresolved stereo indices and changed atoms/bonds; preserve all declared carbon stereochemistry
Element/hydrogen/charge accounting for each proposed reference conversion
Retain literal profile unchanged; specify external curation as a distinct opt-in annotation profile
For every replacement, n_Hplus_new=n_Hplus_old-sum(nu_i*deltaH_i), with exact rational coefficients and unchanged non-H composition; no arbitrary water additions
Recompute complete structural gates on all affected source reactions, retain all unaffected outcomes, report gained/lost/remaining failures and explicit unsupported cases
Retain source biological identity versus specific microstate distinction; graph/proton accounting does not establish Gibbs-energy equality or validated protonation parameters
counterfactual_selection: All live nontransport inputs from the existing43650-request audit; no reaction/label/error selection.
rejection_rules: Refuse changed source hashes or ambiguous external identity
Refuse changed cofactors without a source-owned explicit curation receipt; do not infer from common names alone
No relaxation of stereo gates or silent thermodynamic equivalence for imidate/amide tautomerization
experimental_and_numerical_scope: Structural admission counts only. Numerical coverage, calibrated uncertainty, experimental prediction accuracy and production adoption remain unestablished.
resources: Single bounded CPU, all native thread caps1; network primary-source requests <=5persecond; no fleet or GPU work.
